f.origin = False
f.size = tile_height  # 16

# New logic: use CJK char for scaling
cjk_metrics = f.get_metrics\('\\uAC00'\)
if cjk_metrics and cjk_metrics[0]:
    cjk_advance = int\(cjk_metrics[0][4]\)
    print\(f'CJK advance at size 16: {cjk_advance}'\)

        scale = tile_width / cjk_advance
        f.size = int\(tile_height * scale\)
        print\(f'Rescaled to: {f.size}'\)
    else:
        print\(f'No rescaling needed \(CJK advance == tile_width\)'\)

print\(f'Final font.size = {f.size}'\)
print\(f'Tile: {tile_width}x{tile_height}'\)

pygame.freetype.init\(\)

f.size = 16

# All special chars found in main_menu.py and common UI
chars = {
    0x2726: 'STAR-4',    # ✦
    0x00B7: 'MIDDOT',    # ·
    0x2554: 'BOX-TL',    # ╔
    0x2550: 'BOX-H',     # ═
    0x2557: 'BOX-TR',    # ╗
    0x2551: 'BOX-V',     # ║
    0x255A: 'BOX-BL',    # ╚
    0x255D: 'BOX-BR',    # ╝
    0x25B8: 'TRIANGLE',  # ▸
    0x2500: 'LINE-H',    # ─
    0x2502: 'LINE-V',    # │
    0x250C: 'CORNER-TL', # ┌
    0x2510: 'CORNER-TR', # ┐
    0x2514: 'CORNER-BL', # └
    0x2518: 'CORNER-BR', # ┘
    0x2588: 'BLOCK',     # █
    0x2593: 'SHADE-D',   # ▓
    0x2592: 'SHADE-M',   # ▒
    0x2591: 'SHADE-L',   # ░
    0x25CF: 'CIRCLE-F',  # ●
    0x25CB: 'CIRCLE-E',  # ○
    0x2605: 'STAR-F',    # ★
    0x2606: 'STAR-E',    # ☆
    0x266A: 'NOTE',      # ♪
    0x25A0: 'SQ-FILL',   # ■
    0x25A1: 'SQ-EMPTY',  # □
    0x2191: 'ARROW-U',   # ↑
    0x2193: 'ARROW-D',   # ↓
    0x2190: 'ARROW-L',   # ←
    0x2192: 'ARROW-R',   # →
}

for cp, desc in chars.items\(\):
    try:
        surf, rect = f.render\(chr\(cp\), fgcolor=\(255,255,255\)\)
